race.comment: TERRESTRIAL LIGHT (9) is a promising type who was in the placings on debut before a fourth last time over 1225m at Geelong. Will be handy despite the tricky draw and looks capable of testing this field. MILLSY'S AWARD (4) was well in commission last start over 1350m at Donald when sixth, beaten 3 lengths. Can bounce back. MISTER SOLLY (5) has become a bit of a professional third placegetter and only needs to hold his form to again be filling a trifecta slot here. YANKEE STREET RAIN (10) made an encouraging start to the campaign and has placed at two of four second-up runs, so can feature here.
